# Pipeline Handoff Checklist: Colour Restoration Modes

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality for colour restoration mode configuration, raw-image SfM/COLMAP invariants, restored-image splatting handoff, and reuse/overwrite behaviour.
**Created**: 2026-06-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the required `colour_restoration` block, allowed `mode` values, defaulted `mode`, `overwrite`, and `start_sfm_immediately` fields all specified with ownership outside `project`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001-FR-004]
- [x] CHK002 Are failure requirements defined for missing `colour_restoration`, invalid modes, legacy `project.recolour_images`, and legacy `project.start_sfm_immediately`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005-FR-007, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK003 Are maintained examples, dataset configs, test configs, contracts, and generated examples all included in the migration scope? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements complete for all three mode behaviours: `off`, `gray_world`, and `manual`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014-FR-020]
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements complete for both same-run restored image reuse and explicit regeneration across `gray_world` and `manual` modes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022-FR-023]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the raw-image-only rule for SfM feature extraction, matching, reconstruction, and COLMAP undistortion stated unambiguously for every colour restoration mode? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK007 Is the phrase "splatting-stage image inputs" defined clearly enough to distinguish it from SfM and COLMAP undistortion inputs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, Key Entities]
- [x] CHK008 Is `gray_world` correction strength specified with an exact value and no GUI involvement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, FR-019]
- [x] CHK009 Is `start_sfm_immediately` clearly limited to manual mode background raw-image SfM behaviour? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, FR-013, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK010 Is "safe" manual corrected output reuse defined with enough criteria to avoid subjective interpretation? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-025]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Are the spec, plan, data model, CLI contract, and tasks consistent that colour-restored images are never SfM or COLMAP undistortion inputs? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Plan §Constraints]
- [x] CHK012 Are off-mode requirements consistent that existing recoloured outputs are ignored for SfM, COLMAP undistortion, and splatting? [Consistency, Spec §US2, FR-014]
- [x] CHK013 Are gray-world requirements consistent that restored outputs are generated before splatting consumes them, while raw-image SfM geometry remains unchanged? [Consistency, Spec §US3, FR-017]
- [x] CHK014 Are manual-mode blocking requirements consistent that only splat work needing colour-restored images is blocked by active or incomplete manual state? [Consistency, Spec §US4, FR-028]
- [x] CHK015 Are no-silent-fallback requirements consistent with same-run reuse and incompatible output rejection requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021-FR-024]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Are success criteria measurable for config migration success and legacy config failure rates? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001-SC-003]
- [x] CHK017 Are success criteria measurable for off mode creating zero colour state files or restored outputs? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK018 Are success criteria measurable for gray-world restored output count and dimension preservation? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK019 Are success criteria measurable for raw-image SfM/COLMAP use in every mode and restored-image splatting use only after compatible completion? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-006, SC-010]
- [x] CHK020 Are success criteria measurable for reuse versus regeneration when `overwrite` is false or true? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-009]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK021 Are primary flows covered for validating config, running off mode, running unattended gray-world mode, and continuing manual mode? [Coverage, Spec §US1-US4]

- [x] CHK024 Are recovery requirements defined for incomplete automatic restoration outputs and explicit regeneration paths? [Coverage, Recovery Flow, Spec §Edge Cases]
